svg.title: Search function: design and build
svg.desc: The search function pipeline, translator to mock API to suggester, as designed (left) and as built (right).
svg.text: A request goes through the translator and the mock API; the suggester steps in only when nothing is found.
The same pipeline with the types it passes and what changed while building, outlined in amber.
filler words dropped; a filter wins
tight API: a state in, raw results out
loosens one value at a time, fixed order:
{ original state, results with their states }
Two callers, one function (choices F, J):
the search button through a small API
Rules, not a model (choice J): they play
from the catalog as a list, trip types,
price phrases; the rest stays as text.
A tight API (choice H): it assumes only what
the real Search API does. Whole-word text
Runs only when the raw results are empty
(choice I). Loosens the state one value at a
time in a fixed order and calls the mock
API for each, within a fixed number of
calls. Ordered by how little was loosened.
The page shows the results; the tags compare
each result’s state with the original.
Why a search comes back empty, and who fixes it
→ the agent: one new, targeted search
→ the agent: adds a word (choice M)
each value alone, then growing prefixes
each result carries its own state
trimmed view of each result, plus the
nearest departure when dates were loosened;
is not a change: no history step.
Reads only three things: a max price phrase,
catalog destinations, trip types. Dates, duration,
age band, effort: filters only. A request has
Takes a state, not a request: the translator
runs first. Price = cheapest bookable departure
that matches the filters; all departure filters
hold on the same departure; trip types AND,
Nine values: dates, price, duration, age band,
effort, private room, then the text as three:
the words, the trip types, the destinations.
Ordered by the value loosened first, then by
distance; a trip found twice is listed once.
The output survives JSON unchanged: it travels
between the server and the page.
Example search({ text: "hiking in Argentina under 2000" })
state { text: "hiking", destinations: ["Argentina"], maxPrice: 2000 } → mock API: [] → suggester:
#23 Argentina €4,169 (price loosened), then #1 Italy €719 … five trips (destination loosened)
Left: the plan (DESIGN.md) · Right: the prototype as built (BUILD.md)
